title: HM-ONH Biomechanics UQ: Code and data for myopic optic nerve head modeling
description: Research code and simulation datasets accompanying the manuscript "Finite element modeling and global uncertainty quantification of myopic optic nerve head biomechanics for axial-length-stratified safe intraocular pressure estimation". Includes parameterized ONH geometry and FEBio input generation, Latin hypercube designs and extracted simulation outputs, Gaussian process surrogate models, Sobol sensitivity analyses, a simulated 10,000-eye Gaussian Copula cohort, model-based equivalent IOP boundaries, and figure/table reproduction scripts. No patient-level clinical data are included. Model-derived equivalent IOP estimates require independent clinical validation.
